name: crypto.ecdh
doc: Elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman key agreement on P-256 and P-384.

items.name: GenerateKey
items.doc: GenerateKey returns a random P-256 private key (32-byte scalar).
items.summary: GenerateKey returns a random P-256 private key (32-byte scalar).

items.name: GenerateKeyP384
items.doc: GenerateKeyP384 returns a random P-384 private key (48-byte scalar).
items.summary: GenerateKeyP384 returns a random P-384 private key (48-byte scalar).

items.name: PublicKey
items.doc: PublicKey returns the 65-byte uncompressed P-256 public point of priv.
items.summary: PublicKey returns the 65-byte uncompressed P-256 public point of priv.

items.name: PublicKeyP384
items.doc: PublicKeyP384 returns the 97-byte uncompressed P-384 public point of priv.
items.summary: PublicKeyP384 returns the 97-byte uncompressed P-384 public point of priv.

items.name: SharedSecret
items.doc: SharedSecret returns the 32-byte x coordinate of priv times the (validated) peer point.
items.summary: SharedSecret returns the 32-byte x coordinate of priv times the (validated) peer point.

items.name: SharedSecretP384
items.doc: SharedSecretP384 returns the 48-byte P-384 shared secret with peer.
items.summary: SharedSecretP384 returns the 48-byte P-384 shared secret with peer.
